dashboard.title: Migration Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Configure and monitor your Telegram data transfer in real-time.
dashboard.tooltip_auto_fallback: ⚠️ DANGER: If active, restricted chats will automatically download & upload files using your internet connection. Very slow and high data usage! Also increases ban risk if abused.
dashboard.tooltip_throttle: ⚠️ WARNING: Disabling Safe Mode Throttle removes speed limits. This can cause Telegram to temporarily ban your account with FloodWait errors.
dashboard.sync_info: Real-time sync will run indefinitely in the background.
dashboard.tooltip_session: Select the Telegram account to be used as the executor (bot/sender) for transferring data.
dashboard.tooltip_source: The source of messages. Enter an ID, username (@channel), or click the Search button to browse your chats.
dashboard.tooltip_dest: The destination where messages will be sent. Enter an ID, username (@group), or browse your account directly.
dashboard.tooltip_disable_dup: ⚠️ WARNING: Turning off duplicate protection poses a high risk of triggering Telegram's Spam filters and will send endless duplicates.
dashboard.tooltip_disable_limit: ⚠️ WARNING: Turning off the message limit will make the engine run endlessly. High risk of triggering FloodWait.
dashboard.tooltip_transfer_mode:
Select the delivery method:

1. ⏩ Fast Forward: Fast, no quota used, but 'Forwarded from' label remains.

2. 🚀 Instant Clone: Instant, no forward label (appears as new upload). ⚠️ Warning: Don't abuse to avoid Spam limits!

3. ✨ Clean Copy: ⚠️ WARNING! Downloads the physical file and re-uploads it. Drains internet QUOTA and is VERY SLOW. 100% clean without trace.
dashboard.tooltip_dup_action: Action to take when an identical file exists in the destination. ⚠️ WARNING: Using 'Force Send' defeats duplicate protection and might trigger spam filters.
dashboard.tooltip_msg_limit: Maximum number of messages to scan/transfer in a single execution session.
dashboard.tooltip_caption_rule: Rules for media captions. You can keep original, remove all text, strip ad links (URLs), or replace with custom text.
dashboard.tooltip_media_filter: Select the type of file to transfer. E.g., if Video is selected, Photos and Documents are ignored.
dashboard.tooltip_size_filter: Filter by file size (MB). Leave empty or 0 for no size limits.
